# Glyph reference

Each glyph has a name, which links to its definitions and examples. A function glyph also has a name for its monad, which takes one argument, and for its dyad, which takes two. Operators take functions or arrays and derive functions. Notes give glyph-specific differences from Dyalog APL. Examples show an equivalent BPL value after `⍝`.

## Typing glyphs

Hold Alt, which is Option on a Mac, and press the key in the Key column. Keys refer to a US layout, and no glyph needs Shift with Alt. Where the column shows a second key, release Alt and press it: `Alt-c t` is Alt-C, then T. A second key that needs Shift also works unshifted, unless the unshifted key types a glyph of its own: `Alt-q ,` types `⍃`, as `Alt-q <` does, but in the circle family `\` types `⍉`, so `⌽` needs `|`. An Alt key that starts such a sequence types its own glyph when Space or an unlisted key follows it, so Alt-o then Space gives `○`. Backspace or Escape cancels it. Superscripts start with Alt-6, followed by a digit, `-` and a digit, `t` or `u`. Subscripts start with Alt-5, followed by a digit, or `-` and a digit. A glyph with no key, such as `+`, is on an ordinary ASCII key. The arrows are on hjkl. Alt-[ is left vacant, because terminals encode it as the start of control sequences. Alt-7 gives `∆` and Alt-7 then `_` gives `⍙`, which are identifier characters.

The names are the ones you type. In the REPL, a backtick and any glyph, monad or dyad name, then Tab, enters the glyph, as [named entry](repl.qmd#named-entry) describes. Python exports the function names, with `_` in place of `-` and a trailing `_` on Python keywords, as in `index_of` and `and_`.

| Glyph | Key | Monad | Dyad | Note |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `+` [add](glyphs/add.qmd) | | conjugate | plus | Character offsets as BQN: `'a'+3` is `'d'` |
| `-` [dash](glyphs/dash.qmd) | | negate | subtract | Character difference as BQN: `'d'-'a'` is `3x` |
| `×` [mul](glyphs/mul.qmd) | Alt-m | sign | times | |
| `÷` [div](glyphs/div.qmd) | Alt-u | reciprocal | divide | Exact rationals as J: `1x÷3x` is `1r3` |
| `⌊` [floor](glyphs/floor.qmd) | Alt-d | floor | min | `⌊/⍬` is `∞` |
| `⌈` [ceiling](glyphs/ceiling.qmd) | Alt-s | ceiling | max | `⌈/⍬` is `¯∞` |
| `\|` [stile](glyphs/stile.qmd) | | magnitude | residue | |
| `*` [star](glyphs/star.qmd) | | exponential | exponent | |
| `⍟` [log](glyphs/log.qmd) | Alt-o * | logarithm | log | |
| `○` [circle](glyphs/circle.qmd) | Alt-o | cis | circle | Monad is `*0j1×Y`, a unit-circle point. Pi times is `π` |
| `π` [pi](glyphs/pi.qmd) | Alt-p | pi-times | pi-ratio | Monad takes over Pi times from `○`. `XπY` is Xπ÷Y |
| `√` [root](glyphs/root.qmd) | Alt-3 | sqrt | root | As BQN's `√`, with complex results: `√¯4` is `0j2` |
| `!` [factorial](glyphs/factorial.qmd) | | factorial | binomial | |
| `⍭` [prime](glyphs/prime.qmd) | Alt-Backslash ~ | prime | prime-mode | As J's `p:`, with the same codes |
| `⨸` [factor](glyphs/factor.qmd) | Alt-o u | factors | factor-spec | As J's `q:`, with `∞` and `¯∞` for J's `_` and `__` |
| `⌻` [polynomial](glyphs/polynomial.qmd) | Alt-q t | polynomial | polyval | As J's `p.`: coefficients are constant-first |
| `¿` [inverted-question](glyphs/inverted-question.qmd) | Alt-/ | roll | deal | Dyalog's `?` |
| `∨` [or](glyphs/or.qmd) | Alt-9 | real-imag | gcd | Monad as J's `+.` |
| `∧` [and](glyphs/and.qmd) | Alt-0 | polar | lcm | Monad as J's `*.` |
| `⍲` [nand](glyphs/nand.qmd) | Alt-0 ~ | square | nand | Monad as J's `*:` |
| `⍱` [nor](glyphs/nor.qmd) | Alt-9 ~ | double | nor | Monad as J's `+:` |
| `~` [tilde](glyphs/tilde.qmd) | | not | without | Searches the major cells of `Y`: `s~" "`, not `s~' '` |
| `=` [equal](glyphs/equal.qmd) | | classify | equal | Monad as J: one mask row per distinct major cell |
| `≠` [not-equal](glyphs/not-equal.qmd) | Alt-] | unique-mask | not-equal | |
| `<` [less](glyphs/less.qmd) | | — | less | |
| `≤` [less-or-equal](glyphs/less-or-equal.qmd) | Alt-, | decrement | less-equal | Monad as J's `<:` |
| `>` [greater](glyphs/greater.qmd) | | — | greater | |
| `≥` [greater-or-equal](glyphs/greater-or-equal.qmd) | Alt-. | increment | greater-equal | Monad as J's `>:` |
| `≡` [match](glyphs/match.qmd) | Alt-= | depth | match | Depth has no sign, as in APL2 and BQN |
| `≢` [tally](glyphs/tally.qmd) | Alt-= / | tally | not-match | |
| `⍴` [rho](glyphs/rho.qmd) | Alt-r | shape | reshape | `⍬⍴Y` gives a rank-0 array: `⍬⍴1 2` is `⊂1` |
| `,` [comma](glyphs/comma.qmd) | | ravel | catenate | |
| `⍪` [table](glyphs/table.qmd) | Alt-Minus , | table | catenate-first | |
| `⌽` [reverse](glyphs/reverse.qmd) | Alt-o \| | reverse | rotate | |
| `⊖` [reverse-first](glyphs/reverse-first.qmd) | Alt-o Minus | reverse-first | rotate-first | |
| `⍉` [transpose](glyphs/transpose.qmd) | Alt-o Backslash | transpose | reorder-axes | |

| `↓` [drop](glyphs/drop.qmd) | Alt-j | split | drop | |

| `⊆` [nest](glyphs/nest.qmd) | Alt-z _ | nest | partition | Splits along the first axis |
| `⊃` [mix](glyphs/mix.qmd) | Alt-x | mix | pick | Monad as Dyalog `⎕ML≥2`. Pick takes cells: `1⊃2 3⍴⍳6` is `3 4 5`. A string picks by [key](keyed.qmd) |
| `⌷` [squad](glyphs/squad.qmd) | Alt-q \| | materialise | index | Negative positions count from the end. `∞` takes a whole axis and `¯∞` reverses it |
| `⍳` [iota](glyphs/iota.qmd) | Alt-i | iota | index-of | `⍳⍠A Y` returns axis selectors. A negative length counts down, as J: `⍳¯3` is `2 1 0` |
| `:` [colon](glyphs/colon.qmd) | | unkey | keyed | Removes or adds [axis keys](keyed.qmd). Not in Dyalog APL |
| `⍸` [where](glyphs/where.qmd) | Alt-i _ | where | interval-index | Dyad counts the boundaries at or below each value, as BQN's `⍋`: `1 3 5⍸0 3 9` is `0 2 3` |
| `∊` [member](glyphs/member.qmd) | Alt-e | enlist | member | Searches the major cells of `Y`, as BQN |
| `∪` [union](glyphs/union.qmd) | Alt-v | unique | union | Compares major cells, as BQN |
| `∩` [intersection](glyphs/intersection.qmd) | Alt-c | — | intersection | Compares major cells, as BQN |
| `⍷` [find](glyphs/find.qmd) | Alt-e _ | — | find | |
| `⍋` [grade-up](glyphs/grade-up.qmd) | Alt-7 \| | grade-up | grade-up-by | |
| `⍒` [grade-down](glyphs/grade-down.qmd) | Alt-g \| | grade-down | grade-down-by | |
| `#` [hash](glyphs/hash.qmd) | | — | replicate | Replicates major cells, as Dyalog's `⌿`. Expand is `#⁻¹`: `1 0 1#⁻¹10 20` is `10 0 20` |
| `⊤` [encode](glyphs/encode.qmd) | Alt-n | binary-encode | encode | As J's `#:`, with digits on the last axis |
| `⊥` [decode](glyphs/decode.qmd) | Alt-b | binary-decode | decode | As J's `#.`, with digits on the last axis |
| `⌹` [domino](glyphs/domino.qmd) | Alt-q u | inverse | matrix-divide | |
| `⊣` [left](glyphs/left.qmd) | Alt-; | same-left | left | |
| `⊢` [right](glyphs/right.qmd) | Alt-' | same | right | |
| `⍎` [execute](glyphs/execute.qmd) | Alt-b t | execute | lookup | `X⍎Y` is `Y⊃X`, and runs no code. Dyalog executes `Y` in namespace `X` |
| `⍕` [format](glyphs/format.qmd) | Alt-n t | format | format-spec | |

## Operators

`f`, `g` are functions; `a`, `n`, `r` are arrays or numbers.

| Glyph | Key | Form | Meaning | Note |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `/` [slash](glyphs/slash.qmd) | | `f/` | Reduce / seeded reduce last | Seed as BQN's `´`: `10 -/1 2 3` is `¯8`. For windows use `↕`. Replicate is `#` |
| `⌿` [slash-bar](glyphs/slash-bar.qmd) | Alt-Minus / | `f⌿` | Reduce / seeded reduce first | Seed and windows as `/` |
| `\` [backslash](glyphs/backslash.qmd) | | `f\` | Scan / seeded scan last | Accumulates left to right as BQN's Scan: `-\1 2 3` is `1 ¯1 ¯4`. Expand is `#⁻¹` |
| `⍀` [backslash-bar](glyphs/backslash-bar.qmd) | Alt-Minus Backslash | `f⍀` | Scan / seeded scan first | Left to right as `\` |
| `¨` [each](glyphs/each.qmd) | Alt-1 | `f¨` | Each | |
| `⍨` [commute](glyphs/commute.qmd) | Alt-1 ~ | `f⍨`, `a⍨` | Self / commute / constant | |
| `⍃` [before](glyphs/before.qmd) | Alt-q < | `f⍃g`, `a⍃f` | Before / bind left | As BQN's `⊸` |
| `⍄` [after](glyphs/after.qmd) | Alt-q > | `f⍄g`, `f⍄a` | After / bind right | As BQN's `⟜` |
| `⍤` [rank](glyphs/rank.qmd) | Alt-1 t | `f⍤r` | Rank | `⍤0` passes an atom as itself and an array enclosed |
| `∘` [atop](glyphs/atop.qmd) | Alt-t | `f∘g` | Atop | As BQN's `∘` |
| `⍠` [axis](glyphs/axis.qmd) | Alt-q : | `f⍠A` | Apply along axes | Axes are numbers or names, in place of Dyalog's `f[A]` |
| `⍥` [over](glyphs/over.qmd) | Alt-1 o | `f⍥g` | Over | |
| `.` [dot](glyphs/dot.qmd) | | `f.g` | Inner product | Outer product is `g⊗`. After an array, `T.name` is `"name"⊃T`, and `x.[I J]` is `[I J]⌷x` |
| `⊗` [outer-product](glyphs/outer-product.qmd) | Alt-o m | `g⊗` | Outer product | As BQN's `⌜`; `∘.g` is a `SYNTAX` error |
| `⌸` [key](glyphs/key.qmd) | Alt-q = | `f⌸` | Key | |
| `⍣` [power](glyphs/power.qmd) | Alt-1 * | `f⍣n`, `f⍣∞`, `f⍣g`, `f⍣[g]` | Iterate / invert / fixed point / repeat until / history until | A list of counts gives the result for each count, as J's `^:` and BQN's `⍟`: `(1+⍣3 ¯2 0 3)10` is `13 8 10 13` |
| `⇄` [inverse-pair](glyphs/inverse-pair.qmd) | Alt-4 | `f⇄g` | Attach an explicit inverse | As J's `:.` |
| `⊘` [valences](glyphs/valences.qmd) | Alt-o / | `f⊘g` | Call `f` with one argument, `g` with two | As BQN's `⊘` |
| `⌾` [under](glyphs/under.qmd) | Alt-o t | `f⌾g` | Transform, apply, inverse-transform | As J's `&.` |
| `∂` [derivative](glyphs/derivative.qmd) | Alt-f | `f∂` | Gradient / vector–Jacobian product | |
| `⍚` [agenda](glyphs/agenda.qmd) | Alt-Backtick _ | `selector⍚cases` | Select and call one function | As BQN's `◶` |
| `@` [at](glyphs/at.qmd) | | `f@a`, `a@g` | Functional amend | |
| `⌺` [stencil](glyphs/stencil.qmd) | Alt-q Backtick | `f⌺a` | Stencil | |

## Syntax and literals

| Form | Key | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `←` [assign](glyphs/assign.qmd) | Alt-h | Assignment, including modified and selective forms |
| `→` [pipe](glyphs/pipe.qmd) | Alt-l | Left-to-right function application |
| `(…)` [parentheses](glyphs/parentheses.qmd) | | Grouping. With `⋄`, a vector of rows: `(4 ⋄ 4 5)` is `[[4] [4 5]]` |
| `[…]` [brackets](glyphs/brackets.qmd) | | Vectors and arrays: `[a b c]`, `[a;b c]`, `[1 2 ⋄ 3 4]`. One item makes a one-item vector: `[x]` is `,⊂x` |
| `{…}` [braces](glyphs/braces.qmd) | | Defined function or operator. `;` separates its bodies |
| `⍺` [alpha](glyphs/alpha.qmd), `⍵` [omega](glyphs/omega.qmd) | Alt-a, Alt-w | Left / right argument |
| `⍶` [alpha-underbar](glyphs/alpha-underbar.qmd), `⍹` [omega-underbar](glyphs/omega-underbar.qmd) | Alt-a _, Alt-w _ | Left / right operand |
| `∇` [del](glyphs/del.qmd), `⍢` [del-diaeresis](glyphs/del-diaeresis.qmd) | Alt-g, Alt-1 g | Function / operator self-reference |
| `?` [question](glyphs/question.qmd), `::` [error-guard](glyphs/error-guard.qmd) | | Predicate / error guard inside dfns |
| `⋄` [diamond](glyphs/diamond.qmd) | Alt-Backtick | Separates statements, rows inside brackets, and rows of a vector inside parentheses |
| `⍝` [comment](glyphs/comment.qmd) | Alt-c t | Comment |
| `⎕←` [quad](glyphs/quad.qmd) | Alt-q | Explicit output. Read alone, the next line of input |
| `•` [bullet](glyphs/bullet.qmd) | Alt-y | [System name](#system-names) prefix |
| `⍬` [zilde](glyphs/zilde.qmd) | Alt-o ~ | Empty numeric vector |
| `'…'` `"…"` [quote](glyphs/quote.qmd) | | Character and string literals |
| `¯` [overbar](glyphs/overbar.qmd) | Alt-Minus | Negative literal sign |
| `∞` [infinity](glyphs/infinity.qmd) | Alt-8 | Real infinity |
| `$t` `$f` `$n` [constants](rules.qmd#numbers) | | True, false and NaN |
| `²` `⁻¹` `ᵀ` `ᵘ` [superscript](glyphs/superscript.qmd) | Alt-6 | Postfix on the item before it: `x²` is `x*2`, `f²` is `f⍣2`, `f⁻¹` is the inverse of `f`, `mᵀ` is `⍉m`, and `fᵘ` is a scalar holding `f` |
| `₁` `₋₁` [subscript](glyphs/subscript.qmd) | Alt-5 | Postfix on the array before it: `v₁` is `1⌷v`, `v₋₁` is the last major cell, and `v₁←5` assigns to that cell |

Numeric notation `x`, `r`, `j`, `E`: see [numbers](rules.qmd#numbers).

## System names

Names are case-insensitive. `•a` and `•d` are constant arrays; the other names are functions, usable with operators and composition.

| Name | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `•a` [Alphabet](glyphs/alphabet.qmd) | Uppercase Latin alphabet |
| `•d` [Digits](glyphs/digits.qmd) | Decimal digits |
| `•c` [Case](glyphs/case.qmd) | Unicode case conversion |
| `•csv` [CSV](data.ipynb#csv) | CSV text → keyed column vectors |
| `•tocsv` [CSV](data.ipynb#csv) | Keyed column vectors → CSV text |
| `•r` [Regex](regex.ipynb) | Compiled search, captures and replacement |
| `•normal`, `•binomial`, … [Distributions](distributions.ipynb) | Sampling, density, CDF and quantiles; 17 families |
| `•json` [JSON](data.ipynb#json) | JSON text → arrays and keyed vectors |
| `•tojson` [JSON](data.ipynb#json) | Arrays and keyed vectors → JSON text |
| `•vfi` [Numeric input](data.ipynb#numeric-input) | Parse numeric fields with a validity mask |
| `•nget` [Read](data.ipynb#files) | Read UTF-8 text or bytes |
| `•nput` [Write](data.ipynb#files) | Write UTF-8 text or bytes |
| `•element`, `•xml`, `•svg` [XML and SVG](xml.ipynb) | Build, serialize and display element trees |
| `•mime` [Rich display](xml.ipynb#rich-display) | The MIME bundle that display uses |
| `•plot` [Plots](plot.ipynb) | Charts from vectors, matrices and tables |
| `•ucs` [Unicode](glyphs/unicode.qmd) | Unicode code points / encodings |
| `•load` [Load](glyphs/load.qmd) | Evaluate a BPL source file |
| `•signal` [Signal](glyphs/error-guard.qmd#signal) | Raise an ordinary BPL error |
| `•storage` [Storage](rules.qmd#numbers) | Name the storage that holds an array's items |
| `•time` [Timing](repl.qmd#timing) | Seconds since a time, or each function's fastest time per call |
| `•nc` [Name class](introspection.ipynb) | Classify visible names |
| `•nl` [Name list](introspection.ipynb) | List names by class and prefix |
| `•src` [Source](introspection.ipynb) | Function/operator source |
| `•ex` [Expunge](introspection.ipynb) | Erase bindings |

Index origin: 0. Negative positions and axes count from the end. Comparison tolerance: `1E¯14`.

## Language-wide differences from Dyalog APL

- [Vectors](glyphs/brackets.qmd): brackets write vectors, `[a b c]`, and a strand of literals can leave them out, `1 2 3`. Brackets round one item make a one-item vector: `[5]` is `,5`. [Parentheses](glyphs/parentheses.qmd) round a literal group it: `(5)` is `5`, and `⊂5` is a scalar. Arrays side by side also form a vector: `a b` is `[a b]`. Parentheses with `⋄` write a vector of rows: `(1 2 ⋄ 3)` is `[[1 2] [3]]`.
- [Runs](rules.qmd): outside brackets, a space separates runs, and each run is evaluated first: `a+b × c+d` is `(a+b)×(c+d)`. A run that ends in a function is a train: `+/÷≢` is the mean, and `2×` is `2⍃×`. A run that ends in a dyadic operator takes the next run as its right operand: `f⍤ 1` is `f⍤1`.
- [Indexing](glyphs/squad.qmd): brackets write vectors and never index. Index selects: `0⌷v` is the first item of `v`.
- [Atoms](rules.qmd#arrays-nesting-and-fill): numbers, characters and functions are atoms, distinct from scalars, as BQN. Enclosing always adds a layer: `(⊂3)≡3` is `0x`.
- [Numbers](rules.qmd#numbers): bare numbers are approximate. `x` and `r` mark exact integers and rationals, as J: `1x÷3x` is `1r3`. Predicates, positions, tally and shape are exact.
- [Agreement](rules.qmd#agreement-and-pervasion): pervasive functions, Each and Rank align leading axes, and dimensions of length 1 expand: `(2 3⍴⍳6)+10 20` is `[10 11 12 ⋄ 23 24 25]`.
- [Major cells](principles.qmd#functions-act-on-major-cells): `∊ ~ ∪ ∩` compare major cells, `N#Y` replicates them, `N⊂Y` and `N⊆Y` split along the first axis. `⊤` and `⊥` put digits on the last axis, as J.
- [System names](#system-names): written `•name`, as BQN, not `⎕NAME`. Most Dyalog system functions and variables are not included.
- [Axis keys](keyed.qmd) name data. `K:Y` evaluates its keys. `T.a` is `"a"⊃T`, and `X⍎Y` is `Y⊃X`.
